2608.04552.title: Relational Response Fields: A General Theory of Black-Box LLM Response Consistency and Recovery
2608.04552.paper_summary: Black-box language-model reliability is commonly pursued by sampling, prompting, voting, verifying, or iteratively revising individual answers. We ask a prior question: \emph{what determines whether a collection of black-box responses is recoverable at all?} We represent responses to typed transformations of a query as a \emph{relational response field} (RRF). Edge transports encode how valid responses must change under paraphrase, scaling, decomposition, refactoring, or other task symmetries; anchors encode independently trusted evidence such as execution or a verifier. For relation operator $D$, anchor operator $A$, and at most $k$ corrupted response nodes, we identify $γ_k(D,A)$ as the intrinsic difficulty of black-box response recovery. It is positive exactly when every $k$-node corruption is identifiable; it gives a deterministic stability bound proportional to $1/γ_k$; and a matching two-point minimax lower bound shows that no estimator can improve this dependence. Thus consistency is not truth: relation-only methods are blind to null directions, including shared hallucinations. We derive sparse field-repair algorithms while separating information-theoretic identifiability from the stronger null-space conditions required by convex optimization. Controlled theorem tests and black-box mathematics/code experiments evaluate four theory-fixed consequences: consistency--truth separation, anchor phase transitions, redundancy saturation, and cross-model, cross-task prediction of repair difficulty. The results support $γ_k(D,A)$ as a measurable property of a response-recovery instance, rather than a score attached to one repair heuristic.
2608.04552.paper_summary_zh: 黑箱語言模型的可靠性通常透過抽樣、提示、投票、驗證或反覆修訂個別答案來追求。我們提出一個先前的問題：\emph{什麼決定了一組黑箱回應是否完全可恢復？} 我們將對查詢的類型轉換的回應表示為\emph{關聯回應場}（RRF）。邊緣傳輸編碼了有效回應在意義重述、縮放、分解、重構或其他任務對稱下必須如何改變；錨點編碼了獨立可信的證據，如執行或驗證者。對於關係運算子 $D$、錨點運算子 $A$，以及至多 $k$ 個損壞的回應節點，我們將 $γ_k(D,A)$ 確定為黑箱回應恢復的內在難度。當每個 $k$-節點損壞可識別時，它是正的；它提供了一個與 $1/γ_k$ 成比例的確定性穩定性界限；而一個匹配的雙點最小最大下界顯示，沒有估計器可以改善這種依賴。因此，一致性並不等於真實性：僅基於關係的方法對空方向是盲目的，包括共享的幻覺。我們推導出稀疏場修復算法，同時將信息理論可識別性與凸優化所需的更強的空間條件分開。受控的定理測試和黑箱數學/代碼實驗評估了四個理論固定的後果：一致性—真實性分離、錨點相變、冗餘飽和，以及跨模型、跨任務的修復難度預測。結果支持 $γ_k(D,A)$ 作為回應恢復實例的可測量性質，而不是附加於某一修復啟發式的分數。
